summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (93/13)

data.turoyo: <...> Koḥoyanno, kalé tamo xd i=dukṯo hawxa d məǧləs d malko d howe, kiba šawʕo=mətrowat yurxo w tloṯo, arbʕo pətwo w dkoṯe d u=itowo, xd u=šəkəl d ak=kuresi, faqat disa štile innu d m i=šeno.
data.translation: <...> Ich schaute: da war etwas wie der Versammlungsraum eines Königs, etwa sieben Meterlang und drei vier Meter breit, und Plätze zum Sitzen wie Stühle, aber wieder aus dem lebendigen Felsen gehauen.

rationale: Thin Part. Pass. cell; plural carved seats with m- material, contrasting singular altar-space.

before: aus einem alten Dingen ein neues machen;
after: aus einem alten Dingen ein neues machen; (Detrans., mit m-) aus vorhandenem Material geformt, aus Felsen gehauen sein;
rationale: Adds the Detransitive material/result meaning already illustrated at 93/15 and independently supported by carved seats at 93/13. Does not assert an unattested active rock-carving use.

summary: Both occurrences checked. Part. Pass. štile and štilo describe plural seats and singular altar-space, without an expressed agent.
Material m i=šeno is a source/material complement. Expanded attributive/result forms have no causative prefix and do not warrant stem III.
A carving interpretation already exists in the inherited example. The proposal is merged into sense1 with an explicit Detransitive gloss clause, avoiding renumbering.
The two corpus verses attest only carved results; an active carve base is not invented from the etymology or translation.
Confirm how broadly štl covers reshaping from existing material versus rock carving; new corpus evidence is limited to Detransitive results.
Review the inherited (fig.) placement beside the horticultural example; these two architectural verses do not determine its intended scope.
Correct the singular noun after “einem”: Dingen → Ding
rationale: The singular dative determiner “einem” requires “Ding”; “Dingen” is the plural dative form.
